text: Dropbox is a publicly listed company: its Class A common stock has been listed on the Nasdaq under the symbol DBX since 23 March 2018.
short: Dropbox has been listed on the Nasdaq since 2018.

source.name: Dropbox – Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended 31 December 2025 (SEC)
source.quote: Our Class A common stock has been listed on the Nasdaq Global Market under the symbol "DBX" since March 23, 2018.
